name: ORGABIO
recent: Orgabio 正在推进以 RM11.26 million 现金收购雪兰莪 Semenyih 一块永久地契土地及单层建筑，用于仓库发展。公司将于 2026 年 11 月 27 日召开第八届常年股东大会，并寻求股东批准更新经常性关联交易授权。近期多名董事及大股东申报在公开市场增持少量股份。
notable: 全资子公司 Orgabio Manufacturing Sdn. Bhd. 于 2026 年 9 月 3 日签署买卖协议，以 RM11,260,000 现金收购 Semenyih 一块约 5,263 平方米的永久地契土地及单层建筑，用于仓库发展。
以进行收入或贸易性质的经常性关联交易，并将在即将召开的常年股东大会寻求批准。
公司将于 2026 年 11 月 27 日召开第八届常年股东大会。
risks: 多名董事及大股东于 2025 年 9 月 30 日至 10 月 1 日期间在公开市场申报增持股份，涉及 Dato' Ean Yong Tin Sin、Mr Ean Yong Hien Voon、Mr Ean Yong Hen Loen、Miss Ean Yong Sik Siew、Mr Ean Yong Hian Wah 等人。

news.title: Orgabio proposes RM11.3mil Selangor land acquisition
Orgabio to buy Semenyih industrial property for RM11.26m for warehousing

recent_en: Orgabio is proceeding with a RM11.26 million cash acquisition of a freehold land and single-storey building in Semenyih, Selangor, for warehouse development. Several directors and substantial shareholders recently reported small open-market acquisitions of shares.
notable_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Orgabio Manufacturing Sdn. Bhd. signed a sale and purchase agreement on 3 September 2026 to acquire a freehold land of approximately 5,263 sq m with a single-storey building in Semenyih for RM11,260,000 cash, for warehouse development.
The company proposes to renew the existing shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions of a revenue or trading nature and will seek approval at the forthcoming AGM.
risks_en: Several directors and substantial shareholders, including Dato' Ean Yong Tin Sin, Mr Ean Yong Hien Voon, Mr Ean Yong Hen Loen, Miss Ean Yong Sik Siew and Mr Ean Yong Hian Wah, reported open-market acquisitions of shares between 30 September and 1 October 2025.
